observed_in: Stealth and Awareness System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls how different lighting conditions affect player visibility and creature awareness. Variations can include mechanics such as shadows providing cover, light sources revealing or obscuring entities, and the effect of noise created in different lighting situations.
exclusion_criteria: No interaction between light and sound in stealth mechanics
inclusion_criteria: Shadows provide tactical advantages or disadvantages
title: Lighting Impact on Stealth Mechanics
